function: Two-step MIMO-NOMA downlink detection: convolutional autoencoder denoises the received signal, then a dual-receiver DNN detects each user's symbols without SIC (p. 1).
system: Downlink MIMO-NOMA: BS with 8 transmit antennas, two users (near, far) with 8 receive antennas each, power ratio 0.4:0.6; no RIS; band not stated (pp. 2, 4).
method: Denoising convolutional autoencoder (reconstruction MSE plus L2) followed by supervised fully connected DNN classifier (cross-entropy), trained in two separate steps with Adam (pp. 2-4).
data_channel: Self-generated synthetic dataset: stochastic MIMO-NOMA channels with noise and imperfect CSI (rho = 0.1), 6.4M symbols; no standard model or measurements (pp. 2-4).
test_conditions: Trained and tested under identical conditions; fixed t=r=8, rho=0.1, ratio 0.4:0.6; BER and rate versus SNR 0 to 30 dB, near and far users (p. 4).
baselines: Non-learned: conventional SIC with ZF equalizer; learned: one-step DNN and CNN, jointly trained SIC-DNN [18] and AE-DNN [19], jointly trained and two-step CNN-DNN (pp. 3, 4).
metrics: BER (Fig. 3 axis labeled symbol error rate) and achievable rate versus SNR; trainable parameter counts (pp. 4, 5).
complexity: Table I: 160,674 trainable parameters for the proposed model; baselines 160,674 to 177,824; no FLOPs, complexity order or runtime (p. 4).
q1_support: p. 2: "channel modeling with noise injection and imperfect CSI" - self-generated data (p. 3: "synthetic dataset of MIMO-NOMA scenarios"); H_k is a generic complex matrix, and no 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO model or measured data is named.
q2_support: p. 4: "all models are trained and tested under identical conditions" - one setup (t = r = 8, rho = 0.1, ratio 0.4:0.6, Table II); Figs. 3 and 4 sweep SNR only, and no other antenna count, CSI quality or dataset is tested.
q3_support: p. 3: "the jointly trained SIC-DNN architecture from [18]" and one-step DNN and CNN are the learned baselines; p. 4: "Traditional SIC performs worse than other" schemes, in BER (Fig. 3) and achievable rate (Fig. 4).
q4_support: p. 4: "The trainable parameters for all schemes can be seen in Table I" - Table I gives 160674 parameters for the proposed two-step AE-DNN; no FLOPs, complexity order or runtime is reported.
q5_support: p. 3: "synthetic dataset of MIMO-NOMA scenarios under imperfect" CSI and noise - a self-generated dataset; no code or data link or DOI, no public dataset, no measurements.
notes: Include, area 1 (symbol detection for MIMO-NOMA, replacing SIC). Frequency band is not stated. The text says BER but the axis of Fig. 3 reads symbol error rate. Table I read from a zoomed render of p. 4: the CNN-DNN models have 176610 parameters. q3 rests on the SIC-DNN of [18], the one-step DNN and CNN, and traditional SIC; the jointly trained AE-DNN has the same size as the proposed model (160674), so it may be a variant, and q3 does not rely on it. q4 rests on the parameter count only. Hyperparameters were tuned manually (p. 4).
